The main takeaway from our work is that
the ADES can be a good alternative to the conventional chemical pretreatment for biomass fractionation and nanocellulosis production.
the ADES can be used to produce lignin rich solid fraction from lignocellulosic biomass, which can be further fractionated into nanocellulosis.
the ADES is not only able to fractionate the lignocellulosic biomass into cellulose and hemicellulosic rich fractions but can also produce nanocellulosis with high yield.
